channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Writers, Switzerland, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Writers, Switzerland, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
2 new grants landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 20 Jul 2026 (20 Jul to 26 Jul 2026).

  • Comic Creation Grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000. No application fee.
  • Literary Creation Grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Up to CHF 25,000 (writing), CHF 18,000 (theatre texts), or CHF 15,000 (performative literary projects). No application fee.
